stories.h: Google s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
stories.s: Google on Tuesday launched a new site that lets anyone verify whether a piece of media, be it an image, a video, or an audio clip, is generated using AI.
b: techcrunch.com: Google s new SynthID website can identify AI-generated media
techmeme.com: Google launches SynthID Detector, a website that lets users detect AI-generated image, video, and audio media across dozens of common file formats (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)

stories.h: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
stories.s: Google Labs is working on a new AI-powered game-creation platform called Playground for users to build browser-based games using simple text prompts.
b: techcrunch.com: Google experiments with an AI-powered gaming platform
techmeme.com: Google launches Playground, a browser-based, no-code AI game creation platform available to US users aged 18+, powered by Gemini, Nano Banana, and Lyria (Jay Peters/The Verge)
